usageNotes: Use this to check the Proxmox Datacenter Manager subscription status on a specific node — useful for confirming whether enterprise repository access is valid before applying updates. Accessible by all authenticated users (no elevated privilege required). The `status` field is the primary signal: `active` means the key is valid; `expired`, `invalid`, or `notfound` indicate the node will fall back to the no-subscription or community repository.

examples.summary: Retrieve subscription status for a PDM node named 'pdm1'

tips: The `checktime` field is a Unix timestamp; if stale (>24h), the cached status may not reflect a recently applied key.
The `key` and `serverid` fields are only returned if the caller has permission to view them — their absence does not mean no key is set.
A status of 'notfound' is the default when no subscription key has been applied; this is expected on community installations.
Use 'localhost' as the node value when querying the node you are directly connected to.
